newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in lacklustre trade with most traders sidelined on lack of fresh factors, dealers said on Tuesday.

"Rates were steady to higher in the morning on some position adjustments. But there was no follow through buying support and most people were reluctant to open or hold new positions," a local dealer said.

"But some people are waiting for fresh clues to market direction from this Wednesday's issue of the (U.S. November) producer price index and Thursday's release of the (U.S. November) consumer price index data," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Tuesday/Wednesday, Wednesday/Thursday and week-fixed were unchanged from Monday's common 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent, two-months rose 1/16 percentage point to 5-9/16 5-7/16, nine-months was unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent.
